hypothesis: The r^-1 (a^2/r - c*a) form of the accel_step-probe direction at m2 fixed, e in [0, 0.7] is a capacity limit of the 4-layer d_model=64 model. A 6-layer d_model=128 model trained on the same data encodes the true per-snapshot law, so its best accel_step direction fits to a^~3/r^~2.
expected_if_true: In both seeds, accel_step probe R2 >= 0.9 at some layer and beats control by >= max(0.1, control_spread). The symbolic fit to that direction has r exponent in [-2.5, -1.5], a exponent in [2.5, 3.5] and fit_error_vs_true_law < 0.2.
expected_if_false: In at least one seed, accel_step R2 >= 0.8 but the symbolic fit keeps r exponent in [-1.4, -0.6] (an a^2/r-like form) with fit_error >= 0.2, as in seeds 24, 25 and 26 at the smaller size. That would mean the r^-1 form does not go away with roughly 4x more parameters.
